meta.title: 1💗1 · How it all connects: from a request to a rikma, income and split
meta.description: An animated map of 1💗1: customer and request, founder and dream, rikma, missions and resources, product, income and a split by contribution. See how it connects and where you come in.

hero.sub: A request or a dream, a rikma of partners, work and resources, a product, income and the split. This is the circle from the inside, and at the foot of the page: where you step onto it.

graph.aria: A map of what 1💗1 is made of and how it connects

customer.label: Customer
customer.desc: Someone who needs something that does not exist yet. She does not pick from a shelf: she asks, and she co-signs the deal she pays for.

wish.label: Request
wish.desc: What the customer wrote in the concierge, in her own words. The concierge breaks it into missions and resources.

founder.label: Founder
founder.desc: Someone who wakes up with an idea and wants partners to build it with, without upfront capital and without hiring employees.

dream.label: Dream
dream.desc: The founder's idea. It opens as a rikma, with a list of what is missing to make it real.

rikma.label: Rikma
rikma.desc: The partnership itself. No boss and no employees, only partners who decide together.

partners.label: Partner A, partner B
partners.desc: Partner A took a mission and partner B brought a resource. Neither is the other's boss or employee: both are partners in the rikma, and each gets a share of the profit by what they gave.

mission.label: Mission
mission.desc: Work a partner takes on. Hours are logged with a timer and approved by the rikma. This is where someone joining an existing rikma comes in.

resource.label: Resource
resource.desc: Something a partner brings: equipment, money, a service or a space.

product.label: Product
product.desc: What the rikma gives its customers: a product, a service or an experience.

contribution.label: Contribution
contribution.desc: Everything each partner gave: time, money, equipment and knowledge. Their share of the profit comes from it.

sale.label: Income
sale.desc: Money coming in from a customer. It counts only once whoever holds the money confirms receiving it.

split.label: Split
split.desc: The profit is divided between the partners by what each one contributed, not half and half. The split closes by consent too.

consent.label: Consent
consent.desc: The frame around everything. You approve, talk it through or counter with a more precise version, and there is no outright "no". Silence until the rikma's time runs out means yes to the last version on the table.

steps.request1: A customer says, in her own words, what she needs.
steps.request2: The concierge breaks the request into parts, and a rikma of people who can provide them forms around it.
steps.dream1: A founder wakes up with a dream.
steps.dream2: They open a rikma and writes down what is missing to make it real.
steps.s3: Each part is a mission (work) or a resource (equipment, money, a service, a space). Partner A takes the mission, partner B brings the resource, and both become partners in the rikma.
steps.s4: Partner A's approved hours and the resource partner B gave are recorded as each one's contribution.
steps.s5: What gets built is a product. A customer co-signs the deal and pays, and that is the income.
steps.s6: The income is split between partner A and partner B by what each one contributed, not half and half.
steps.s7: Every step on the way closes by consent, the customer's included. From there the rikma goes on to the next request.

glossary.title: Every box, in words
glossary.sub: The same map, as a list.

doors.title: Where do you come in?
doors.sub: Four ways onto the same circle.

customer.title: I have a request
customer.desc: Say what you need, and the group that makes it happen forms around your request.

founder.title: I have a dream
founder.desc: Open a rikma, write down what is missing, and find partners who get a share of what they build.

partner.title: I want to join
partner.desc: Take a mission or bring a resource in an existing rikma, and your hours turn into ownership.

supplier.title: I have something to give
supplier.desc: Businesses and service providers receive requests that match exactly what they offer.

cta.title: Ready to step onto the circle?
cta.sub: Opening a rikma and inviting partners is free.
